newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BOURSE CLOSING - BULL RUN MAINTAINED, SHARES UP.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE CLOSING - BULL RUN MAINTAINED, SHARES UP.

text.p: * Preliminary data from the Estonian bourse on Tuesday put
total trade at 101.2 million kroons versus 77.3 million kroons.
* The Talse online index gained 1.66 percent to close at
271.44 (See index on stock exchange web site:
* Preliminary closing data put Hansapank as the
most active with 36.9 million kroons traded to be 2.20 higher on
a last deal price of 145.10 kroons.
* Forekspank gained 7.5 kroons or four percent to
close on 191.00 kroons after trade of 20.5 million kroons.
